 War Ukrainian forces reportedly strike Russian targets 2,500 kilometers from border
 October 24, 2026 7:48 pm • 3 min read Prefer on Google by Volodymyr Ivanyshyn What purports to be the aftermath of a reported Ukrainian drone attack on the Russian city of Omsk, located about 2,500 kilometers from Ukraine on Oct. 24, 2026. (Exilenova Plus/Telegram) Editor's note: This is a developing story and is being updated. 
 Ukraine struck several targets, including a petrochemical plant and a warehouse in Siberia around 2,500 kilometers away from the border on Oct. 24, monitoring channels reported.
 A fire first broke out at the Omsky Kauchuk petrochemical plant in the Russian city of Omsk, according to Ukrainian monitoring channel Exilenova Plus.
 The facility is one of Russia's largest petrochemical plants, and the company behind Omsky Kauchuk says the site is a leading producer of synthetic rubber, organic synthesis products, and methyl tert-butyl ether, an additive used to refine gasoline.
 The plant is part of Russia's supply chain for rocket fuel, including for the Iskander ballistic missile used in fatal attacks against Ukraine, Exilenova Plus said.
 Russian ballistic missiles targeted Kyiv in a fatal attack on the night of Oct. 13-14, killing five people and injuring another 25. At least one person was killed, and 24 were injured in another Russian ballistic missile attack overnight on Oct. 22.
 Later, a warehouse belonging to major Russian online retailer Ozon was also hit in the Ukrainian drone attack, Exilenova Plus reported .
 Omsk Oblast Governor Vitaliy Khotsenko confirmed that the region was targeted by Ukrainian drones, saying that a logistics hub in the city of Omsk was hit.
 "A logistics hub in Omsk was attacked by a drone. Personnel were promptly evacuated. Emergency services are working at the scene," he claimed.
 Reports could not be immediately verified by the Kyiv Independent.
 Ozon and its competitor Wildberries have been targeted by Ukrainian forces in recent months. The two are a major part of Russia's economy, with their broader ecosystems accounting for about 8.5% of Russia's GDP.
 Ukraine has targeted facilities that often serve as storage sites for dual-use goods used in weapons production and other military purposes.
 Ukraine regularly strikes military targets deep within Russia and occupied territories in an effort to diminish Moscow's ability to continue waging its war.
 Omsk Oblast was also under fire in an attack on Oct. 8. Ukraine's General Staff confirmed that its forces struck the Omsk oil refinery .
 "The destruction of such facilities is the exercise by Ukraine of its inalienable right to self-defense in accordance with Article 51 of the UN Charter and is aimed at reducing the military-economic potential of the Russian Federation," Ukraine's General Staff said .
 More recently, on Oct. 24, the General Staff said that Ukrainian forces struck the Tolyattikauchuk petrochemical plant in the Russian city of Tolyatti, Samara Oblast, as well as an aircraft at the Yeysk airfield in Krasnodar Krai.
 The synthetic rubbers are used to make solid rocket fuel for tactical and ballistic missiles, according to the General Staff.
 "Damage to such objects affects the supply chain of raw materials for the Russian missile program," Ukraine's General Staff wrote.

 2:27 am  (Updated:   October 25, 2026 3:39 am ) Massive Ukrainian drone attack hits shopping center in Russia's Belgorod Oblast, locals say. MegaGRINN is the largest shopping complex in Belgorod, covering over 163,000 square meters and housing more than 200 shops. The center was closed and empty of visitors during the reported overnight attack. 
 3:29 am Sanctioned Russian energy giant secretly funded US gas project, NYT reports. The gas project was part of an energy deal discussed by U.S. peace envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner during their September visit to the Kremlin, sources told the New York Times.
 12:42 am Deadly Russian drone strike targets apartment in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, killing 3, injuring 12. One of the injured victims is an 11-year-old girl. Five wounded individuals are being treated in the hospital, with two in serious condition and undergoing surgery.
 Saturday , October 24 10:57 am  (Updated:   October 24, 2026 11:47 pm ) Starshield operations restored to normal speed, Zelensky confirms as Elon Musk claims Ukraine violated Starlink terms. "We record a speed of more than 400 kilometers per hour, the connection is stable," the ministry said.
 7:48 pm Ukrainian forces reportedly strike Russian targets 2,500 kilometers from border. Ukraine struck several targets, including a petrochemical plant and a warehouse in Siberia around 2,500 kilometers away from the border on Oct. 24, monitoring channels reported.
 5:22 pm European Parliament Vice President ends hunger strike following Oleshky ceasefire European Parliament Vice President Pina Picierno announced the hunger strike on Oct. 20, demanding an immediate humanitarian truce in the occupied town.
 4:14 pm Germany in talks to buy Ukrainian jet powered drones The Bars jet powered drone has a range of 1,000 kilometers and can reach speeds of up to 700 kilometers per hour. 
 3:12 pm Ukraine sanctions Russian arms suppliers as Moscow ramps up attacks Included in the first sanctions list are 51 Russian citizens and 44 businesses producing and supplying raw materials, equipment, and tools used in long-range weapons like Iskander, Kalibr, Kh-101, and Kinzhal missiles.
 12:43 pm Russian attacks kill 4, injure 78 across Ukraine over past day, as drone strikes Kyiv residential building in the morning. Overnight, Russian forces launched 126 drones, 61 of which were jet-powered, while Ukraine's air defense managed to suppress 101 drones, including 50 jet-powered drones, the Air Force said.
 5:28 pm  (Updated:   October 24, 2026 11:49 am ) Ukrainian forces strike Oryol electronics plant, General Staff confirms, drone attacks shut down Moscow airports. Restrictions were placed on incoming and outgoing flights in Sheremetyevo, Domodedovo, Vnukovo, and Zhukovsky airports, Russian civilian aviation authority Rosaviatsiya reported.
 11:33 am Factories on fire in Russia's Tolyatti amid reported drone attacks Videos filmed by locals show smoke billowing over the city in the early morning, with reports claiming that the Tolyattikauchuk chemical plant was attacked and that evacuations took place at the AvtoVAZ car manufacturing factory.
